_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: The Daily Bread, read from the stored text
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Finding the bread for this morning

description: Return the single verse of the day that every Living Bread user receives on a given date (the app delivers it at each person's local 8am), verbatim from the stored KJV, or from the stored Bible chosen by translation or language (ids from list_translations). Use for "verse of the day" or "today's bread". Not for a verse on a theme (verses_for), a multi-day reading rhythm (reading_plans), or a chosen reference (scripture_passage). date is read as a calendar day only (no time zone math); pass the person's local date, since the verse is fixed per date and any past or future date works. An invalid date, an unknown translation or language, or a verse the chosen translation does not hold returns an error. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

date.description: Calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD, ideally in the person's own time zone, e.g. "2026-10-06". Omit for today (UTC).

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language of the person, e.g. "es", "pt-BR", "sw", "zh-Hant". Picks the best stored public domain or freely licensed translation for that language; translation overrides it.

translation.description: Optional translation id from list_translations, e.g. "bsb", "web", "dra", "rv1909", "lsg", "cuv", "neno", "wlc", "byz". Default: the King James Version (or the language default).

name: daily_bread

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

page.description: Web page with today's verse, a reflection and a prayer.

ref.description: Verse reference, in the chosen translation's own numbering.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

shared.description: One sentence explaining that everyone receives this same verse that day.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

text.description: Verse text, verbatim from the chosen translation.

translation.description: Translation code returned: KJV by default.

translation_name.description: Full name of the translation returned.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: The Daily Bread
